contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' = 1,500.00, equal to BOTH the summary block's This-Report and Totals (cumulative) line-1 cells (1,500.00)
contributions.detail: The single Form A row (Rusty and Lynelle Jensen, 1,500.00) sums to 1,500.00 = the schedule's printed total = the cover's cumulative cell. The 'Last Report' column is empty on line 1 (this is the first report of the cycle - the '7 days before convention' box is checked and that report starts January 1, 2024), so this-report and cumulative coincide.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' = 1,440.18, equal to BOTH the This-Report and Totals (cumulative) line-2 cells (1,440.18)
expenditures.detail: 11 Form B rows: 748.20 + 140.00 + 83.33 + 10.83 + 20.51 + 23.33 + 250.00 + 18.52 + 26.81 + 6.15 + 112.50 = 1,440.18, to the cent. Line-2's 'Last Report' cell is a bare dash, so cumulative equals this report. Ending balance closes independently: 1,500.00 - 1,440.18 = 59.82 = the printed line-3 figure.

escalation_note: 900 dpi --value crops to prove the extrapolated row grids: p6 band 1 x the Amount column (reproduces 1,500.00) after a first exploratory crop showed the header/shade strips, and p7 bands 1 and 11 x the Amount column (reproduce 748.20 and 112.50). One crop initially landed on p7's HEADER strip and was corrected: Form B's header strip is ~2x the row pitch wide (its 'Date of Expenditure' label sets two lines), while Form A's single-line header strip is exactly one pitch - a real difference between the two sheets, recorded here because it is easy to mis-index. No amount was ever in doubt; both printed schedule totals gated the sides.

6.measure_note: Form A is bound ROTATED (landscape, Amount at the TOP of the rendered page and Date at the bottom): the printed column separators are the page's HORIZONTAL rules and the row separators are its VERTICAL rules, so axis='x' and rows advance LEFT-TO-RIGHT (row 1 is the leftmost data band). Column bands from a horizontal-rule projection over the blank x-window 15-40%: 5.05/15.75/57.82/87.95/96.05 = Amount | Address | Name of Contributor | Date. Row bands from a vertical-rule projection over the table's y-extent at coverage 0.40 (27 rules, regular 3.06-3.18 pct pitch); the rule at 6.76 is the sheet's outer border and the bands [9.15,12.26] / [12.26,15.44] are the printed header strip and the shaded scan-fold strip, NOT data rows. PROVED with a 900 dpi --value crop of band 1 x the Amount column, which reproduces 1,500.00.

7.measure_note: Same rotated-landscape geometry as p6. Column bands from the horizontal-rule projection over the blank x-window 60-85%: 2.93/13.64/32.43/43.09/88.36/97.98 = Amount | Purpose of Expenditure | City | Person or Organization | Date of Expenditure. Row bands from the vertical-rule projection at coverage 0.40 (27 rules, pitch ~3.09), with the band at [17.38,20.56] identified as the shaded fold strip and [11.26,17.38] as the two-line-wide printed header strip - neither is a data row. PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops of bands 1 and 11 x the Amount column, which reproduce 748.20 and 112.50.

notes: TYPED 2024 form, four pages: p4 cover (name/office/report-type checkboxes/signature) whose three-column summary block is CUT OFF at the foot - only the 'Totals from + Totals for = Cumulative' headings print there; the summary figures themselves are on p5, where that copy heads the columns 'Last Report | This Report | Totals:'. Page position is not the form order here either: the money block is a page later than its own headings. FORM A on p6, FORM B on p7, both bound rotated. The candidate's street address on p4 is BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (a government-applied redaction, preserved, not a value the filer left empty); nothing behind it is recovered. No per-page SUBTOTAL is printed on either schedule - each prints one grand total at its foot, and that is the gate. No in-kind row and no negative amount on either schedule.
